_comment: Tollgate permission manifest. Deny by default; scope each agent to the tools it may call on each MCP server. Precedence is deny > review > allow, and BOTH deny and review are hard floors unioned across every matching scope — so never list a tool under review (or deny) that you also want allowed, and never use a review/deny glob that overlaps an allowed tool (it would override the allow). This example lets the `claude` agent READ the Cortex second brain (memory_search, memory_stats flow straight through), holds any WRITE for a human in the Approvals Inbox (memory_add/delete/update — defense in depth: gated now even though this read-only Cortex build does not expose them, so a rug-pull that adds one is already caught), and denies everything else — every other tool, agent, and server.
